documents.text: Revenue was $125 million in fiscal 2024, compared with $100 million in fiscal 2023, an increase of 25%.
Operating margin improved to 18% in fiscal 2024 from 16% in fiscal 2023.
Net income for fiscal 2024 was $18.5 million, while diluted earnings per share were $2.14.
At year end, cash and cash equivalents were $42 million and total current assets were $310 million.
Capital expenditures totaled $12.4 million in fiscal 2024, primarily for manufacturing equipment.
The company declared a quarterly dividend of $0.35 per common share during fiscal 2024.
